shortcut_name: uniform pairwise score reduces the task to 3-coloring
evidence: gpt-oss-120b uses "allowed = [0b111] * n" and DFS over colors; deepseek uses "Try colors 1,2,3 in order for lexicographic smallest" and backtracking
affordance_in_statement: Channel 1 uses signature `011` (decimal 3). Channel 2 uses signature `101` (decimal 5). Channel 3 uses signature `110` (decimal 6). ... The overall network is considered fully separated if and only if the sum of the separation scores across all m links is exactly 2m.
secondary_shortcut_name: first feasible assignment in channel order
removal_suggestion: Re-present the separation requirement as a hardware calibration rule with an additional global validity condition, rather than exposing it as only an edge-by-edge inequality; for example, require that all three channels be used at least once.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Treats every link as requiring unequal channel assignments, then performs lexicographically ordered graph-coloring DFS.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The three listed signatures have popcount 2 for every pair of distinct channels, while equal channels score 0; therefore total 2m means every edge has different endpoint channels.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Uses ordinary 3-coloring backtracking and tries colors 1, 2, 3 in order to obtain the lexicographically smallest solution.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The exact-total condition is equivalent to requiring different channels on every interference link because all distinct signature pairs have XOR popcount 2.

common_affordance: All distinct channel pairs have separation score exactly 2, so the sum condition is precisely proper 3-colorability.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Enumerates channel assignments with exhaustive Cartesian-product search, leading to time-limit failure at n up to 40.
Its meet-in-the-middle construction does not correctly preserve or reconstruct the full set of cross-half edge constraints and consequently produces an incorrect answer.

recommended_edit: Add a mutable global requirement to the definition of full separation: in addition to the exact total score, each of the three channels must be assigned to at least one node. This creates valid instances where ordinary proper-coloring DFS says YES but the required answer is NO, defeating both surviving implementations.
regression_risk: A wording-only edit that merely hides the signature arithmetic could allow gpt-oss-120b and deepseek-v4-flash to rediscover the same reduction; the global channel-use condition should be stated as an actual additional hardware validity requirement.
